_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd dont_starve/egg-don-t-starve-together.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail fixes the config downloads (upstream fetches github.com/…/blob/ HTML pages; Octail fetches the raw files pinned to the commit it was based on), gives the Caves shard its own automatic port (CAVES_PORT instead of a fixed 11000 nobody could reach), writes the cluster token (SERVER_TOKEN, required) to cluster_token.txt before every start (upstream wrote it once at install, so a new token never took effect), detects the start from Master's "Sim paused" (the world is loaded and waiting for players; upstream's start line came before the world loaded), updates before every start by default (upstream: off; clients refuse an outdated server), broadcasts with c_announce, makes the install fail when SteamCMD or a config download failed, and adds the dont-starve-together tag, install sandbox defaults and resource hints (3 GB for the two shards). SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Don't Starve Together
author: parker@parkervcp.com
description: Don’t Starve Together is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic.

startup_commands.Default: mkdir -p DoNotStarveTogether/config/server && printf '%s' "${SERVER_TOKEN}" > DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster_token.txt; cd bin64 && coproc caves ( ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -bind_ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{CAVES_PORT}} -persistent_storage_root /home/container/DoNotStarveTogether -conf_dir config -cluster server -players {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -shard Caves ); ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -bind_ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -persistent_storage_root /home/container/DoNotStarveTogether -conf_dir config -cluster server -players {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -shard Master && echo 'c_shutdown()' >&"${caves[1]}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'debian:buster-slim'
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +force_install_dir /mnt/server +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/bin64/dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Don't Starve Together dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## DST specific
## cluster token file
echo -e "getting cluster configs"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster_token.txt ]; then
    echo "${SERVER_TOKEN}" >> /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster_token.txt
fi

## cluster configs 
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster.ini ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/dont_starve/server.cluster.ini -o /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster.ini || { rm -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/cluster.ini; echo "Downloading cluster.ini failed"; exit 1; }
fi

## master configs
echo -e "getting master configs"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/
## master ini
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/server.ini ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/dont_starve/server.master.ini -o /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/server.ini || { rm -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/server.ini; echo "Downloading Master/server.ini failed"; exit 1; }
fi

## master worldgen override
if [ ! -z ${MASTER_WORLDGEN}  ] && [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/worldgenoverride.lua ]; then
    curl -fsSL ${MASTER_WORLDGEN} -o /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/worldgenoverride.lua || { rm -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Master/worldgenoverride.lua; echo "Downloading the Master worldgen override failed"; exit 1; }
fi

## caves configs
echo -e "getting cave configs"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/
## caves ini
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/server.ini ]; then
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/dont_starve/server.caves.ini -o /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/server.ini || { rm -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/server.ini; echo "Downloading Caves/server.ini failed"; exit 1; }
fi

## caves worldgen override
if [ ! -z ${CAVES_WORLDGEN} ] && [ ! -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/worldgenoverride.lua ]; then
    curl -fsSL ${CAVES_WORLDGEN} -o /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/worldgenoverride.lua || { rm -f /mnt/server/DoNotStarveTogether/config/server/Caves/worldgenoverride.lua; echo "Downloading the Caves worldgen override failed"; exit 1; }
fi

echo -e "install complete"

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description:
Set the maximum number of players that will be allowed to join the game. This option overrides the [GAMEPLAY] / max_players setting in cluster.ini.

default is 16

variables.name: Server Token
variables.description: Required: the server does not start without a Klei cluster token. Make one at https://accounts.klei.com/account/game/servers?game=DontStarveTogether (Add New Server, then copy the token) or in the game (Play, Account, Generate Server Token). It is written to cluster_token.txt before every start.

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description: Update the server through SteamCMD before every start. 1 to update (the default; players can't join a server older than their game), 0 to start the installed files.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: Valid values are survival, endless or wilderness

variables.name: Cluster Name
variables.description: This is the name that will show up in server browser.

variables.name: Cluster Description
variables.description: This will show up in the server details area on the “Browse Games” screen.

variables.name: Master Worldgen Override
variables.description: Link to the lua file used to generate the master server map. Only used during the install phase.

variables.name: Caves Worldgen Override
variables.description:
Link to the lua file used to generate the caves server map. Only used during the install phase.

Default generates a cave map

variables.name: Caves Port
variables.description: UDP port of the Caves shard; players connect to it when they go underground. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).
